inputApproverId.title: inputApproverId
inputApproverId.description:
Salesforce user ID of the claim approver executing the approval or
rejection decision. Used for audit trail and participant records.

inputApproverNotes.title: inputApproverNotes
inputApproverNotes.description: Optional notes or justification provided by the approver when approving or rejecting the warranty claim.

inputClaimName.title: inputClaimName
inputClaimName.description:
Warranty claim reference extracted from the user message.
Supports numeric and prefixed formats such as 847, 0847, or WC-2026-0847.

inputDecision.title: inputDecision
inputDecision.description:
Approval decision derived from the user's intent.
Expected values are Approved or Rejected.
